releases.name: Smartphone
releases.summary: 見知らぬ密室で目を覚ました主人公。 頼れるものは、手元に残された一台のスマートフォンだけ。 通話、メッセージ、アプリなどに残された痕跡をたどりながら、脱出の手がかりを探していく。 しかし、情報を集めるほどに、 この事件の裏に隠された異様な真実が浮かび上がっていく。 スマートフォンを操作して進める、サイコロジカル・ホラーADV。

releases.name: Finish The Dishes!
releases.summary: Finish The Dishes! is a fast-paced arcade shooter set on a chaotic kitchen countertop. Blast pests, exploit their weaknesses, upgrade your arsenal, and chase perfect five-star runs.

releases.name: AFTERLIGHT: The Apartment
releases.summary: Explore an early-2000s Korean apartment complex in this short first-person psychological horror experience.

releases.name: The Odyssey Simulator
releases.summary: Play as Achilles in the Odyssey Simulator. Battle through the Trojan War, unlock powerful gear, defeat larger than live foes, and forge your path to immortal glory.

releases.name: The Library on the Lake
releases.summary: Library on the Lake is a narrative multiverse where players take on the mantle of the Archivist. Undo a magical curse by traveling into different books to repair corrupted stories. Explore other worlds, meet a unique cast of characters, and play engaging mini games.

releases.name: Ink Rush
releases.summary: A first-person platforming action game where a girl must escape a strange space-like dream world with a magical water gun. Use red, blue, yellow, and black ink abilities to climb, wall-run, stick to ceilings, defeat enemies and bosses, and escape a giant monster in a frantic chase.

releases.name: Dice Chemist
releases.summary: A dice-poker roguelike where lucky rolls become alchemical combos. Roll, hold, and chain catalyst synergies to clear twelve rounds — and beyond.

releases.name: Desktop Tarot
releases.summary: Desktop Tarot is a feature-rich tarot reading game for your desktop, designed to be intuitive and atmospheric. Choose classic spreads such as the Celtic Cross or create your own. Shuffle, draw, and arrange the cards your way, then explore detailed interpretations for every card.

releases.name: Don't Wait Until There Are No Flowers to Pluck: Git Reboot Log for Test Takers
releases.summary: 现实里没有 git checkout，错过的分支无法回滚。但在这里，你可以。 这是一个写给「做题家」的纯爱文字 AVG：习惯用理性防御情感的男主「陆渊」，在博士毕业那天喝下一杯名为「重构」的酒，重回 2019 年夏天。 五条互斥纯爱单线，10万+字剧情。在这个赛博时空里，去解开当年无解的谜题，跑通属于你的唯一分支。

releases.name: Warrior Spirits
releases.summary: A martial arts card battler inspired by one of my favorite childhood games. Experience a story-driven adventure, level up your fighters, build your deck, shape your playstyle with stat upgrades, conquer roguelike runs, battle Raid Bosses, and fight players around the world in online pvp.

releases.name: Blocky Powers
releases.summary:
BLOCKY POWERS is a block-stacking game that combines realistic physics with 2-player local multiplayer. Build the tallest and most stable tower with your friends and enjoy an exciting competition! 

You can't win just by stacking blocks. Every block is affected by weight and balance and will sway. Furthermore, strong winds will hit your tower, and even a small mistake will lead to collapse.

releases.name: The Escape From Dungeon Keep
releases.summary: A classic text RPG: type commands to explore, fight turn-based battles, manage inventory, upgrade gear, and finish side quests. Chase multiple endings, New Game+ content, achievements, and moddable Workshop maps.

releases.name: Mireglow
releases.summary: Step into a peaceful mystical swamp filled with wonder and hidden discoveries.

releases.name: Dawn One
releases.summary: 100% mouse-driven — Hot, fast and brutal hack and slash pure action gauntlet.

releases.name: The ordinary case of Margaret Luoni
Skijoring
releases.summary: Crash into your friends in Skijoring, the unhinged sport of push and pull. Get wild airtime, screen-peek to survive, and embrace co-op chaos in the world's first, best, and only arcade skijorer.
